## Decision: Use an arbitrary filename to prove name-agnosticism

This decision record uses a date-prefixed name
(`20260712-foo.md`) instead of the fleet's
`clone-topology-decisions.md` convention. The import path must
preserve the filename verbatim, so the round-trip exercises the
name-agnostic claim with a non-canonical name.

### Status

Accepted. Companion to the realistic-format decision record.
